notes.title: Plans for the future
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I wanted to give a big thanks to all of you for playing my first game. I will be using this experience to make my future games better. I’ve already started on the next game and provided some details below, along with some screenshots on what I worked on so far.

[h3]What’s planned for the next game?[/h3]
[*]More Characters - Specifically more women you can have sex with. But also characters that’s related to the story as well.
[*]More Lewd Animations - You can expect more animated sexual content with sound effects.
[*]Choices with consequences - The next game will be heavily focused on the story, where your choices will have a significant impact on situations and characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011263/fb6a92df0bbb68477ba327da9e4d8be52c114300.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011263/edb3b7f237688e02767d8a378f3983e643943078.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011263/5dbe3cb923f52940a8f7075b37ac387049acfd0b.png[/img]
I’m unsure when exactly I will finish developing this game, but I’m aiming to release it in the year 2025. That’s all the information I have for now and thank you once again. 

Kind regards,
LewdPalace
